div.div:
Blue: pre-mixer real CIC. Orange: mixer + NCO. Green: post-mixer boxcars + CORDIC.
Purple: AM envelope path. Yellow: carrier-PLL / lock / PM (dashed = WITH_PM). One 125 MHz clock domain.
